title: Backups, resilience and testing your restores

videos.script: The shop's backup job runs every night. It has never printed an error. {{job}} In this lesson ana restores it for the first time, into an empty folder, and compares the result with the real data. {{restore}} The invoices are missing. They were added to the server after the job was written in March, and the job was never told. Every night since, it has succeeded at backing up the wrong thing. {{missing}} That is why a backup is only as good as its last restore test. You will fix the job, restore again, and prove the copy with a checksum. {{prove}} Along the way, the rule of three copies, two media and one off site, and the two numbers that say how much a shop can afford to lose. {{rule}}
